tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the account, user, and credential behind this connection, with plan, credit balance, rate limits, and the tools available. Call it first to verify the setup.

tools.name: ask_crevio
tools.description: Delegate a job to the Crevio agent and wait for the result. Starts a run that works your account through the Crevio API (products, customers, orders, email, socials, sites, research), waits up to timeout_seconds, and returns the run with the agent's final reply in `result`. For anything longer, use

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Open a chat with the Crevio agent and queue a run, without waiting. Returns the run immediately — its `chat_id` is the conversation to continue with send_message. Follow the run with wait_for_run or get_run.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the account's chats, newest first.

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Get a chat's title, kind, and latest run.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Continue a chat with follow-up instructions or answers — the agent keeps its context. Resumes a run waiting in needs_input, or queues a new run when the last one finished. Returns run_busy while a run is still in progress. Optionally waits for the reply.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read a chat's messages, oldest first. Returns the most recent `limit` messages; page back through older ones with starting_after.

tools.name: wait_for_run
tools.description: Wait for a run to settle (completed, failed, or needs_input) and return it with the agent's final reply. Returns wait_timed_out if it is still running when the timeout passes; call again.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a run's current status, summary, pending approvals, and (once settled) the agent's final reply.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the account's task runs, newest first — delegated jobs and scheduled tasks alike. Filter by status or task.

tools.name: resolve_approvals
tools.description: Approve or deny the integration actions a run is paused on (status needs_input with pending_approval_ids). Submit a decision for every pending id at once; the run resumes in the background.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Stop a run that is pending, running, or waiting for input. The run is finalized as failed with 'Cancelled by the caller'.

tools.name: api_search
tools.description: Discover available Crevio API endpoints. Use this BEFORE `api_execute` when you're unsure which endpoint to call, need to check parameter names, or want to explore what's available for a domain (e.g. "experiences", "discounts"). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, api_search, api_execute · Private data: whoami, api_execute · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message, resolve_approvals, api_search, api_execute · Destructive: ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run, api_execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, api_search, api_execute · Private data: whoami, api_execute · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message, resolve_approvals, api_search, api_execute · Destructive: ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run, api_execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
